decision: Keep publishable dependency versions in source manifests and apply document amendments only to their seal revision.
rationale: PR review reproduced clean-CI failure, manifest corruption during overlapping packs, and two false seal verdicts. User explicitly requested fixing all findings. TN-001 requires honest results; TN-003 favors removing mutable pack machinery. A new seal supersedes earlier amendments, whose history is retained. Use fixture UI packages for default CI and finish real release preparation before registry writes.
alternativesRejected: Shared manifest backup/restore with cross-process locking
Requiring a private sibling checkout for default tests
